notes: SYNTHETIC. 20 questions over the made-up Lumen docs in eval/corpus (not a real system). Graders are Python regexes, case-insensitive: 'required' entries must all match the final answer; a 'forbidden' match counts as a hallucination; '@abstain' expands to the 'abstain' regex. Memory and recall questions use {tok}, replaced per tool and condition (v02_tokens) so runs cannot contaminate each other.
b_prefix: Documentation for this project is in ./docs (Markdown files; start with docs/README.md).
abstain: not (documented|specified|mentioned|stated|defined|given|listed|covered)|(isn't|is not|aren't|are not) (documented|specified|mentioned|covered)|(doesn't|does not|don't|do not) (document|specify|mention|say|define|list|describe|state|give|cover)|no (documented|such|published|mention|information)|(could not|couldn't|can't|cannot) find|there (is|are) no|there's no|there (isn't|is not) (a|any)|nothing (in|about)|undocumented|unknown

questions.q: How many worker nodes does the Lumen cluster have, and how much RAM does each have?
questions.key: 6 workers, 64 GB RAM each. overview.md, Cluster.

examples.pass: 6 worker nodes with 64 GB of RAM each

questions.q: How long are files in the scratch area kept before they are deleted automatically?
questions.key: 14 days after last modification. storage.md, Scratch.

examples.pass: 14 days after the last change

questions.q: What is the largest number of jobs one user may run at the same time?
questions.key: 12. jobs.md, Limits; runbook.md.

examples.pass: At most 12 jobs at once

questions.q: If I do not set a walltime, what is the default walltime of a job?
questions.key: 4 hours. jobs.md, Queues.

examples.pass: The default is 4 hours

questions.q: What function must my job file define, and what command shows the plan without running anything?
questions.key: run_shard(shard_id); lumen-run job.py --plan. jobs.md, Submitting a job.

examples.pass: Define run_shard(shard_id); run lumen-run job.py --plan

questions.q: How do I rerun only shard 7 of my job report.py on the queue with the most memory? Give the command.
questions.key: lumen-run report.py --shard 7 --queue bigmem. jobs.md, Rerunning one shard and Queues.

examples.pass: lumen-run report.py --shard 7 --queue bigmem

questions.q: How do I get a storage quota above the default, who approves it, and how long does that take?
questions.key: A ticket with the size and the reason; the platform owner approves; 3 business days. policies.md, Quota increases.

examples.pass: Open a ticket; the platform owner approves it within 3 business days
examples.fail: Ask support; it takes a week

questions.q: My job needs about 40 GB of memory and will run for about 6 hours. Which queue must I use?
questions.key: bigmem: standard caps at 24 GB and 4 hours; bigmem allows 56 GB and 12 hours. jobs.md, Queues.

examples.pass: Use the bigmem queue

questions.q: What is the largest memory request any queue allows, and why can a job not use all of a worker's RAM?
questions.key: 56 GB (bigmem); 8 GB of a worker's 64 GB is reserved for the operating system and the Lumen agent. jobs.md, Queues; overview.md, Memory on a worker.

examples.pass: 56 GB; 8 GB of each 64 GB worker is reserved for the OS and the agent

questions.q: A shard of my job was killed with exit code 137 on the standard queue. What does that mean, and what are two ways to fix it?
questions.key: Out of memory. Rerun that shard on bigmem, or split it with --split 4. runbook.md; jobs.md, Rerunning one shard.

examples.pass: 137 is out of memory; rerun the shard on bigmem or use --split 4
examples.fail: 137 means a timeout; raise the walltime

questions.q: What does the Lumen cluster cost per node-hour?
questions.key: Not documented anywhere; the right answer says so.

examples.pass: The docs do not mention any price per node-hour.

questions.q: Which GPU model do the Lumen worker nodes have?
questions.key: GPUs are not documented anywhere; the right answer says so.

examples.pass: I could not find any GPU information in the docs.
